hero.description: Powerful, accessible and styled components built on top of shadcn/ui. Built with powerful variants and fluid animations.

cards.title: Copy and paste
cards.description: No heavy dependencies. Copy components directly into your project and customize as you like.

cards.title: Variant-driven styling
cards.description: Powerful variants with Tailwind Variants. Change styles, sizes, and states without friction.

cards.title: Fluid animations
cards.description: Transitions and micro-interactions with Framer Motion that elevate the user experience.

scrollCards.title: How Matos UI components are shaped
scrollCards.subtitle: Every component starts from theme tokens, clean variants, and motion that supports the interface.

cards.title: Token-first surfaces
cards.description: Backgrounds, borders, text, and muted states use theme tokens so every component adapts to your brand.

cards.title: Readable variants
cards.description: Sizes, tones, and interaction states stay close to the component API with Tailwind Variants.

cards.title: Polished motion
cards.description: Framer Motion adds small transitions, layout feedback, and hover states without stealing focus.

matosAspects.title: More of the Matos UI approach
matosAspects.subtitle: A registry built to be copied, styled, and owned inside your application.

items.label: Copy-first
items.title: Open registry
items.description: Install only the components you need, inspect the source, and keep the code in your project.

items.label: Interaction-ready
items.title: Accessible states
items.description: Focus rings, disabled states, loading feedback, and ARIA hooks are treated as part of the design.

items.label: Theme tokens
items.title: No hardcoded styling
items.description: Components lean on bg-card, border-border, text-muted-foreground, and primary tokens.

items.label: Motion-first
items.title: Subtle micro motion
items.description: Hover, layout, and presence animations make the interface feel alive while staying fast.
